variables.name: SourceHost
variables.input:
data record(host = "ALL")
| append [ timeseries q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries), by:{dt.entity.host}
    | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
    | filter isNotNull(host)
    | fields host
    | sort host asc ]

variables.name: DnsServer
variables.input:
data record(dnsServerIp = "ALL")
| append [ timeseries q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries), by:{dnsServerIp}
    | fields dnsServerIp
    | sort dnsServerIp asc ]

0.content:
# 🌐 Active Directory — DNS Resolution Health
Client-side DNS resolution as observed by OneAgent on each host: query volume, response time, failures and orphaned (unanswered) requests, split by **source host** and **DNS server**. Use the `SourceHost` and `DnsServer` filters above — `ALL` means unfiltered.

**Error types:** `NXDomain` name doesn't exist (usually stale records / bad search suffixes) · `ServFail` resolver couldn't answer (forwarder / upstream / DNSSEC problem — the one to chase) · `Refused` policy / ACL · `FormErr` malformed query · `NotImp` unsupported query type · `YXDomain`/`NXRRSet` dynamic-update conflicts.  **Query time** is each host's per-interval average across its DNS-server series — exactly the trend-chart line. **Avg** is the mean of that line over the timeframe, **Max** is its highest point. Best / error-rate rankings ignore hosts with fewer than 50 queries in the timeframe.

2.query:
timeseries q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries, scalar: true), by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp}
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
     AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
| summarize event_count = sum(q)

8.query:

| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
     AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
| summarize event_count = sum(e)

10.query:
timeseries { e = sum(dt.host.dns.errors, scalar: true), q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries, scalar: true) }, by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp}
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
     AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
| summarize event_count = round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(e, 0)) / sum(q), decimals: 2)

13.content: # 🔴 Top 5 Worst — Avg Query Time (Source Host)

14.query:
timeseries { qt = avg(dt.host.dns.query_time), q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries), e = sum(dt.host.dns.errors) }, by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp}
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
     AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
| summarize { qt = avg(qt[]), q = sum(q[]), e = sum(e[]), DnsServers = countDistinct(dnsServerIp) }, by:{host, timeframe, interval}
| fieldsAdd Queries = arraySum(q), AvgQueryTime = round(arrayAvg(qt), decimals: 1), MaxQueryTime = arrayMax(qt), Errors = coalesce(arraySum(e), 0)
| fieldsAdd ErrorRatePct = round(100.0 * Errors / Queries, decimals: 2)
| sort AvgQueryTime desc
| limit 5
| fields host, AvgQueryTime, MaxQueryTime, Queries, ErrorRatePct, DnsServers

41.content: # DNS Errors by Server → Error Type  ·  `PctOfTypeTotal` = this server's share of all errors of that type · `PctOfServerQueries` = normalised for how busy the server is

42.query:
timeseries e = sum(dt.host.dns.errors, scalar: true), by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp, errorType}
| fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
| filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
     AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
| summarize { Errors = sum(e), HostsAffected = countDistinct(host) }, by:{dnsServerIp, errorType}
| filter Errors > 0
| lookup [ timeseries e = sum(dt.host.dns.errors, scalar: true), by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp, errorType}
    | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
    | filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
         AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
    | summarize TypeTotal = sum(e), by:{errorType} ], sourceField: errorType, lookupField: errorType, fields:{TypeTotal}
| lookup [ timeseries q = sum(dt.host.dns.queries, scalar: true), by:{dt.entity.host, dnsServerIp}
    | fieldsAdd host = entityName(dt.entity.host)
    | filter (in("ALL", array($SourceHost)) OR in(host, array($SourceHost)))
         AND (in("ALL", array($DnsServer)) OR in(dnsServerIp, array($DnsServer)))
    | summarize ServerQueries = sum(q), by:{dnsServerIp} ], sourceField: dnsServerIp, lookupField: dnsServerIp, fields:{ServerQueries}
| lookup [ fetch dt.entity.host
    | fieldsAdd ipAddress
    | expand ipAddress
    | fields ip = toString(ipAddress), DnsServerName = entity.name
    | dedup ip ], sourceField: dnsServerIp, lookupField: ip, fields:{DnsServerName}
| fieldsAdd PctOfTypeTotal = round(100.0 * Errors / TypeTotal, decimals: 1),
            PctOfServerQueries = round(100.0 * Errors / ServerQueries, decimals: 2)
| sort Errors desc
| fields dnsServerIp, DnsServerName, errorType, Errors, PctOfTypeTotal, PctOfServerQueries, ServerQueries, HostsAffected
